item.title: Who Has It Harder in Life: Men or Women?
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks strangers a thought-provoking question: who has a harder life, men or women? From societal expectations to everyday struggles, people share their perspectives on the different challenges each gender faces.

item.description: Tokyo Sims asks an Indian girl how to say “open-minded” in his language. What starts as a simple question leads to an unexpected cultural exchange on the streets of Tokyo.

item.title: Is a Four-Year Age Gap Too Much for Dating?
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks whether a four-year age difference is too much when it comes to dating. The question sparks a conversation about age gaps, personal preferences, and what really matters in a relationship.

item.title: His PhD Research Involved Working With Live Rats
item.description: During a Tokyo street interview, a man shares an unexpected detail about his academic background: his PhD research involved working with live rats. The conversation takes an interesting turn as he explains his unusual research experience.
